classification.difficultyReason: Factor a difference of squares, reduce the homogeneous factors to tangent equations and select all solutions in the restricted domain.

answer.worked:
The original equation requires $\cos\theta\ne0$.
$$\begin{align*}(\tan\theta-1)(\sin\theta-\sqrt3\cos\theta)(\sin\theta+\sqrt3\cos\theta)&=0.\end{align*}$$
Consider $\sin\theta-\sqrt3\cos\theta=0$. Divide each term by $\cos\theta$:
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta-\sqrt3&=0\\\tan\theta&=\sqrt3.\end{align*}$$
Similarly, for the other factor:
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta+\sqrt3\cos\theta&=0\\\tan\theta+\sqrt3&=0\\\tan\theta&=-\sqrt3.\end{align*}$$
The first factor gives $\tan\theta=1$. Hence
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=1\quad\text{or}\quad\tan\theta=\pm\sqrt3\\\theta&=\frac\pi4,\frac\pi3,\frac{2\pi}3\qquad(0\leq\theta\leq\pi).\end{align*}$$
